title: Mo' Models, Mo' Problems: How to best select model pools when designing Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.17306v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-agent Systems (MAS) combine multiple model outputs to solve complex reasoning tasks. However, despite rapid growth of available open-source models, there is limited research on how to select optimal model candidates out of this massive pool. We systematically evaluate 8 model selection strategies (including model size, accuracy and answer diversity) across before-generation (routing) and after-generation (majority-voting, LLM-as-a-judge) MAS architectures on challenging scientific benchmarks. Our findings show a significant gap between theoretical oracle potential and actual performance: Expanding candidate pool sizes often degrades performance below that of the top performing base-model. We find that candidate selection within a single model family is the strategy that yields the best relative performance over a standalone model. translated_title: 模型越多，问题越多：设计多智能体系统时如何最佳选择模型池
translated_abstract: 多智能体系统（MAS）通过组合多个模型的输出来解决复杂的推理任务。然而，尽管可用的开源模型数量迅速增长，关于如何从这个庞大的模型池中选择最优候选模型的研究仍然有限。我们在具有挑战性的科学基准测试上，系统地评估了8种模型选择策略（包括模型大小、准确率和答案多样性），涵盖了生成前（路由）和生成后（多数投票、LLM作为评判者）的多智能体系统架构。我们的研究结果表明，理论上的神谕潜力与实际性能之间存在显著差距：扩大候选模型池的规模往往会导致性能下降，甚至低于表现最佳的单一基础模型。我们发现，在单一模型家族内进行候选模型选择是相对于独立模型能够带来最佳相对性能提升的策略。这些结果表明，向异构多智能体系统中随意添加任意模型可能会引入系统不稳定问题。
tldr: 盲目扩大多智能体系统的模型池往往会适得其反、导致性能下降，而在单一模型家族内选择候选模型是超越独立单一模型的最佳策略。
en_tdlr: Blindly expanding the model pool in multi-agent systems often degrades performance below the best base-model, and selecting candidates within a single model family is the best strategy to outperform a standalone model.
